items.title: What the Fed Hears and What It Concludes: Supply-Chain Narratives and U.S. Inflation Forecasting ⋆
items.claim: FOMC narratives improve inflation forecast accuracy while Beige Book narratives do not.

items.title: Order Invariance at the Last Language-Model Boundary: A Pre-Registered Test of an LLM Evidence Synthesizer Inside a Deterministic Trading Architecture
items.claim: Language model nondeterminism, not input order sensitivity, drives trading system uncertainty.

items.title: When Stress Tests Miss the Risk: Statistical Scenario Analysis for Financial Portfolios
items.claim: Standard scenario analysis substantially understates portfolio risk by overlooking factor dependence.

items.title: Adaptive State Representation and Critical Explainability Evaluation for A2C-Based Algorithmic Carbon Allowance Trading
items.claim: A2C trading agent performance is sensitive to random initialization despite high reported Sharpe ratios.

items.title: Abstention Is Not Neutral: Ablating the LLM in an LLM Trading Agent
items.claim: Language model trading agent abstention is primarily determined by prompt wording, not market conditions.

items.title: Residual Learning in Empirical Asset Pricing
items.claim: Deep neural networks outperform shallow models in asset pricing when trained with residual learning.
